identity_and_conservation.audit_hook_placement: after frozen group selection/group-cycle computation and before resident removal
identity_and_conservation.qualification: Transaction-model preservation only; no physical address/macro/RTL equivalence follows.

lower_bound_assessment.qualification: Mapping-independent work-conservation lower bound, not proof that any fixed row permutation attains it and not an integrated/RTL/system speedup.

scope_assessment.admitted: Negative screen for four predeclared H0-H3 row-phase mappings, selected as one fixed mode per operator, on the frozen 10-sample/4-operator M89-K6 cohort.
not_admitted: A theorem closing all reversible within-row bank permutations
Address-generation RTL correctness or SRAM macro feasibility
PPA, energy, equal-area, full-network, system, DATE headline or best-paper result
scope_assessment.receipt_wording_correction: Replace 'closing the fixed reversible weight-row bank-skew axis' with 'closing the four predeclared H0/H1/H2/H3 fixed per-operator row-phase mappings on the frozen cohort'.

findings.finding: The experiment enumerates only H0, xor-row, add-row, and add-3row. A reversible row layout can use many other row-dependent permutations; the receipt nevertheless admits wording that closes the entire fixed reversible bank-skew axis.
findings.impact: The exact NO-GO is strong for H0-H3 but cannot be generalized to every offline fixed per-operator bank packing.
findings.required_action: Narrow the admitted claim to the four predeclared mappings and frozen cohort.

findings.finding: The exact result and completion log are hash-bound, but the log does not bind command, host identity, Git commit/tree, Python environment, start/end timestamps, or an input/output SHA inventory emitted by the runner.
findings.impact: Arithmetic and artifact identity are excellent; remote execution provenance is weaker than a sealed fail-closed run receipt.
findings.required_action: Use an exact-SHA runner with environment and command attestation for any future positive bank-layout experiment.

findings.finding: The screen covers ten internal samples and four H67 Conv3x3 operators under one frozen M89-K6 schedule, without sequence-disjoint/event-density strata, Local5, PAFT-changed masks, or external workloads.
findings.impact: The NO-GO is decisive for this milestone but is not a general SNN bank-layout result.
findings.required_action: Broaden evaluation only after PAFT or a newly preregistered mapping produces a positive frozen screen.

findings.finding: The prohibited oracle chooses one aggregate H0-H3 mode per sample×operator record. It does not sum the best mode independently for every frozen group.
findings.impact: Zero oracle gain proves H0 is best for all 40 record aggregates, but can hide within-record group-level wins and losses that cancel.
findings.required_action: If revisiting bank layout, emit a diagnostic-only per-group oracle before designing another fixed mapping.

findings.finding: The 56,660,864-cycle bound balances each group ideally and independently. No single fixed row permutation is shown to attain those simultaneous balances.
findings.impact: The 1.23479x source-only ratio is an opportunity ceiling, not expected or achieved performance.
findings.required_action: Keep the number explicitly labeled as a work-conservation bound and out of headline/result tables.

findings.finding: zero_extra_ports_capacity_and_vector_storage is hardcoded true. The mathematical permutation preserves abstract capacity, but no weight image, address miter, macro pin audit, decoder timing, or switching cost exists.
findings.impact: No RTL/PPA/cycle-frequency conclusion follows from the stage1 model.
findings.required_action: No action for failed M96; require these proofs only after a future mapping passes stage1.

findings.finding: Group audit counts are produced on a base scheduling pass and multiplied by BLOCKS=8 to match record ledgers.
findings.impact: The identity checks make stage1 arithmetic self-consistent, but the scaling is not a physical SRAM activity or address trace.
findings.required_action: Use cycle/address traces only for a future retained implementation.

findings.finding: Reversibility is proven combinatorially for bank labels, not by repacking actual signed weights and comparing decoded values/accumulations.
findings.impact: The intended layout is lossless mathematically, but implementation-level numeric equivalence remains untested.
findings.required_action: Do not build a miter for the failed mapping; make it a promotion requirement for any future positive layout.

next_direction.retain: H0 identity layout plus M89-K6 oldest-seed/saved-first scheduling.
next_direction.priority: Wait for PAFT-changed masks and replay them through the unchanged retained H0 scheduler.
next_direction.bank_diagnostic_if_reopened: Emit dominant-bank/row-phase histograms and a true per-group H0-H3 oracle first.
next_direction.bank_design_resume_condition: Only a preregistered training-set-optimized, held-out frozen per-operator mapping with >0.5% source gain and charged decoder/layout costs should advance.
next_direction.forbidden_approach: Do not guess more hashes, use per-sample/runtime mapping, or promote the 1.23479x lower-bound ratio.
